people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and of the altar, so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites again.
translations.kjv: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar; that there be wrath no more upon the children of Israel.
